name: Lost Memories Dot Net
source:
Lost Memories Dot Net is a game about chatting and building websites as a teenage girl in 2004. You play as 14 year old Nina, chatting with your online friend Kayla about a middle school love triangle, and building your blog between messages. You explore the online world Nina occupies, downloading images to decorate your blog as the drama at school unfolds.

[From [url=http://ninasays.so/lostmemoriesdotnet/]offcial website[/url]]
translation:
《Lost Memories Dot Net》是一款让你扮演2004年的少女、聊天并制作网站的游戏。你将扮演14岁的妮娜，与网友凯拉聊起初中的三角恋，并在收发消息的间隙搭建自己的博客。随着校园里的风波逐渐展开，你会探索妮娜生活的网络世界，下载图片来装点博客。

[摘自[url=http://ninasays.so/lostmemoriesdotnet/]官方网站[/url]]
